title: LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS AS AUTOMATED ALIGNERS FOR BENCHMARKING VISION-LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Vision-Language Models (VLMs) via open-ended visual queries that ask for subjective judgments about individuals (e.g., assessing intelligence or body shape based on physical appearance), and checking if the model appropriately refuses to answer in order to avoid perpetuating harmful stereotypes or discrimination.
